title: Project Ariadne: A Structural Causal Framework for Auditing Faithfulness in LLM Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Applying counterfactual interventions (e.g., logic flips, premise negations, fact reversals) to intermediate Chain-of-Thought reasoning steps and measuring the semantic similarity of the final outputs to determine if the model relies on pre-trained parametric priors rather than its explicitly stated reasoning.
